text:
joanne: Ziggy finally beat the tunnel from hell and built a tiny fluffy igloo at the far end. posted a pic: https://i.imgur.com/6YzQp2H.jpg :tada:

sam: Absolute legend. that victory loaf at the end is iconic :crown: :joy:

nina: HOW does he tuck himself into that perfect crescent? also his ear floof is immaculate :heart_eyes_cat:

ed: Is that... a crumpled receipt serving as a ceremonial flag? 😂

joanne: Yep. we leave one sacrificial napkin in there and he honors it. apparently it's his comfort relic.

giphy: GIF: "tiny triumph" (posted)

sam: Also tagging ops — someone add "Ziggy demo" to next Friday's 2pm slot so we can witness the igloo coronation in person? :raised_hands:

nina: vote: yes please. +1 :thumbsup:

ed: +1. bringing a tiny crown.

joanne: note: Ziggy accepts snacks as tribute. small fish flakes preferred. :fish:

sam: big mood. sending this to the team album — perfect morale booster for midweek. :heart:

nina: unsolicited life tip: if you're having a rough day, open this thread and remember a hamster-sized architect exists.

joanne: mission accomplished. thanks for the love, team! :smile: (reacts: :heart: from sam, :tada: from nina)
